checks.title: Open Graph tags for link previews
Images have alt text
checks.evidence: 17 of 17 homepage images have no alt text.
checks.fix: Add descriptive alt text to meaningful images.

checks.title: Pages are actually indexed
checks.evidence: 77 of 111 known URLs indexed (69%). Discovered-not-indexed: 8. Crawled-not-indexed: 17.
checks.fix: Work the unindexed pages: "Discovered" usually means weak internal linking or crawl priority; "Crawled – currently not indexed" is a content-quality verdict and at scale means a site-quality problem.

checks.title: Keyword targets chosen and tracked
checks.evidence: 0 tracked queries on the site profile.
checks.fix: Run the keyword research process and record targets.

checks.title: Business profile written and confirmed
checks.evidence: No confirmed business profile — keyword generation cannot run without it.
checks.fix: Gather evidence, draft the profile, confirm it with the client.

checks.title: Primary location set (localises all SERP checks)
checks.fix: Set primaryLocation, or record that this site has no geographic market. Unset means SERP checks are not localised and fail silently.

checks.title: Google Business Profile claimed and complete
checks.fix: Categories, service areas, hours, phone, website link, 10+ photos, services list.

checks.title: Review generation process running
checks.fix: Reviews are a local ranking factor and a conversion factor. Set up a repeatable ask (SMS/email after job).

checks.title: Bing Places listing claimed
checks.fix: Free, quick, and feeds other surfaces.

checks.title: NAP consistent across web
checks.fix: Name/address/phone must match exactly on site, GBP and every citation. Inconsistency dilutes local ranking.

checks.title: Core directory citations built
checks.fix: AU set: True Local, Yellow Pages, Hotfrog, StartLocal, Localsearch, plus industry-specific directories.

checks.title: Social profiles claimed and linked
checks.fix: Claim the handles, link them from the site, and reference the site from them.

checks.title: Backlink baseline measured
checks.fix: Needs a paid API (Ahrefs/Moz/DataForSEO) — we currently have no off-page data at all.

checks.title: Link acquisition plan
checks.fix: Suppliers, industry bodies, local sponsorships, existing client sites. Start from competitors' referring domains.
